title: P2 qualification envelope coverage
objective: Bind every P2 qualification envelope member to an executable independently validated product corpus case, expanding or narrowing claims honestly and enforcing mechanical coverage

oracles: backend-neutral expected values and independent validators

handoff.summary: Bound every array-valued P0-P2 capability-envelope claim to an executable product-corpus validation. Four new family cases execute all scalar-root methods, spline boundary families, finite-difference stencil families, and linear-solve methods; existing cases now attest interpolation, Chebyshev, polynomial-root, quadrature, QR, and Cholesky method identities. The adapter computes independent root/function residuals, spline interpolation and endpoint equations, finite-difference analytic error, linear residuals, QR reconstruction/orthogonality, and Cholesky reconstruction/shape. Capability generation now fails closed if any early-product envelope member is unbound, duplicated, widened without a case, or linked to a non-validation check. The audit also corrected inaccurate envelope vocabulary to the actual public result methods and replaced the false finite-difference derivative-order limit with the implementation's 65-point stencil bound. The 69-case campaign validator, qualification evidence suite, numerical architecture surface, lane contract, and direct execution of every added case against the base-compatible built artifact passed.
risks: The versioned corpus and capability specification intentionally invalidate earlier numerical qualification receipts; persistent four-platform receipts must be recollected from the integrated candidate.

A clean local build passed, and the complete architecture wrapper passed FFI, package graph, numerical surface, native, Wasm, workload, resource-lifetime, and CoWasm checks before stopping at an unrelated optimizer-opportunity manifest that was already stale at the pinned base commit. The integration lane must regenerate that shared artifact and rerun the wrapper.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this lane onto the current numerical integration branch, regenerate its shared optimizer-opportunity artifacts, and rerun the complete architecture check.
Collect the version-14 product corpus on Node, npm, SEA, and browser subjects across the persistent four-platform qualification matrix.
